sampling_algorithm: One Python random.Random(seed): sort originals by source_id; shuffle; first floor(N*4/5) train; remaining suffix val; filter augmented families to train; in crater,mountain_rock order sort each pool by (scene,sample_id), sample without replacement; shuffle all train rows
original_pool_definition: Complete former training originals plus complete Moon_5 originals; independent Moon_2/4/9 test is excluded
exclusion_reason: Augmentation source_id belongs to the new validation split
